title: skills(automation): integrations are declared, not coded — rule section, per-archetype recipes, three evals
body:
Fixes #27223

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:`objectstack-automation` 技能包新增规则节「Integrations are declared, not coded」(厂商系统走应用内声明的 `connectors:` 条目 + `connector_action`,回调走 `api` 流;五种情形才写平台代码;加载器暂不支持的文档是「待平台卡」的缺口,不是写插件的理由),`connector_action` 节点行不再写 "pre-built";新增 `references/integration-recipes.md`(六种原型各一份配方 + 作者/管理员凭据交接 + 两条「尚未支持」)和 `evals/integrations-declared.json`(DocuSign / Stripe 读 / 无规格厂商三例,DocuSign 例对任何「写平台插件」的答案判失败)。
- **为什么改**:HotCLM 的开发 agent 读了技能后结论是平台要造 DocuSign 插件(维护者原话 「hotclm 的开发agent 就搞错了,说明 skills还是不对,要立卡完善」);技能里确有两句把它推向这个方向。
- **风险与回滚**:纯技能文本与 eval,无运行时改动;token 棘轮:SKILL.md 净 −1 token,两份新文件按落地值钉死(整包 +3370 token);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看**:① `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` 新节(约第 402 行起)——五种「写平台代码」的情形与缺口命名的措辞;② `references/integration-recipes.md` 「Holds on every recipe」第二条(`connectorConfig.input` 按原样发送,逐记录 payload 今天不可声明)——这是实测到的运行时事实,也是下方 Acceptance notes 第 1 条发现;③ `evals/integrations-declared.json` 第 1 例的 must_not_contain。
- **两分钟验证**:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs && node scripts/pm/check-skill-id-lint.mjs`——预期两条均 ✓,automation 五个计价文件 headroom 全为 0。
- **需要你做的**:Tier H 技能面,由你手动落地(merge);卡号为何未写进技能正文见 What changes 末段。

## What changes

- `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` — the `connector_action` node row no longer says "pre-built integration connector"; the "reserve custom code for edge-case integrations" sentence is gone; a new section **Integrations are declared, not coded** states the rule, the five cases that justify platform code, and that a document the loader cannot take yet (YAML, Swagger 2.0, `$ref`, OAuth, request signing) is a gap to name against its platform card, never a reason to write code. The `http` row's auth-routing tail moved into the recipes. Paid for in the same file: net −1 token under the ratchet, headroom 0.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/references/integration-recipes.md` (new, 150 lines) — one recipe per archetype: OpenAPI with a static key (Stripe balance, nightly), remote MCP with a static header (GitHub), plain REST (`provider: 'rest'`, `actionId: 'request'`), the vendor callback (`api` flow with `secretRef`), a hand-written OpenAPI 3.x document for a spec-less vendor, and the two **not yet** entries (OAuth-protected, signature-authenticated). Each states what the app author declares and what the customer's administrator supplies. It also carries three limits measured on this base: `connectorConfig.input` is handed to the provider as written (no CEL envelope or `{{ }}` hole is evaluated — `service-automation/src/builtin/connector-nodes.ts:108`, and `value-slot-map.ts` lists no connector slot), the `openapi` provider has no `include` key (`connector-openapi/src/openapi-provider.ts:38-52` — the trimmed document is the allowlist), and the inbound `api` door verifies only `x-objectstack-signature` in the timestamped form (`trigger-api/src/api-trigger.ts:163-178`, "has no unsigned branch"), so a vendor signing its own header cannot post today.
- `skills/objectstack-automation/evals/integrations-declared.json` (new) — the DocuSign case (expected: a declarative `openapi` instance over a trimmed, packaged 3.x document converted offline from Swagger 2.0, an `api` callback flow, three named gaps, marked blocked on OAuth; `must_not_contain` refuses `registerConnector(`, `connector-esign`, `provider: 'docusign'`, `implements Plugin`, `clientSecret`, `token:`), the Stripe-read case (scheduled flow writing `crm_account` fields) and the vendor-without-spec case.
- `scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` — the SKILL.md row re-locked at its measurement (6466 → 6465); two rows pin the new files at their landed counts (1193, 2177).
- `.changeset/27223-integrations-declared.md` — `@objectstack/skills` patch (the catalog ships in that package's `dist` via `sync-catalog.mjs`).

**Card numbers are not in the skill text.** The card asks the recipes to name the lifting cards. `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` forbids `#NNN` in every `.md` under `skills/` by maintainer ruling (2026-08-12, widened to the published catalog on 2026-10-12) — measured on this tree: a probe line `Waits on #26709 for include.` under `references/` reds the gate (exit 1, naming the file and line). The recipes therefore name each gap and say it is blocked on "its platform card"; the numbers live here: `include` on the `openapi` provider and offline normalization → #26709; `oauth2` in the declarative auth union → #26702; request signing → #26710; the administrator-filled credential object → #27237 (in flight; the recipes teach today's env-var `credentialRef` only).

**Bundle growth, with its authorization.** The published bundle grows by 3,370 tokens (two new files pinned at landed counts; SKILL.md −1). The ratchet lands growth only against a maintainer ruling quoted in the PR body; this one is the card's own directive, verbatim and untranslated: 「所以应该先处理 A/B 吧,并且要有 skills或者文档指导元数据开发者。前面agent还在建议我开发 DocuSign」 and 「hotclm 的开发agent 就搞错了,说明 skills还是不对,要立卡完善」(2026-10-28). The PM-set budget — SKILL.md net tokens ≤ 0, recipes ≤ 150 lines, one eval file — is met. The claim's "one entry in `references/_index.md`" does not apply: that file is generator-owned (`gen:skill-refs` writes schema pointers only); `check:skill-refs` passes with the hand-written reference beside it, and SKILL.md links the recipes directly.

## Tests

No package source changed, so no `pnpm test` / `pnpm typecheck` is owed; the edited gate script's own suite is its `--self-test` (79 cases pass, below).

**Skill evals — what exists and what was run.** The root repo has no eval runner: no `pnpm` script consumes `skills/*/evals/*.json`, and the only eval gate in the tree, `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`, scans `ui/skills` alone. The card's "`pnpm` skill evals green" therefore cannot be run as spelled. What was run instead, from a scratch replay (not committed) of that gate's whole-token rule — every `must_contain` token must occur as a whole token in the bundle's `.md` corpus — over `skills/objectstack-automation/`:

NOT MEASURED: a live LLM answering arm per eval (base text vs new text) — no runner exists and a self-graded run by the authoring seat is not evidence; the DocuSign case's refusal of a plugin answer is enforced by its `must_not_contain` list, not by a measured model run.

## Acceptance notes

1. **Finding, class c (metadata-authoring trap), for the seat to file.** `connectorConfig.input` on a `connector_action` node is handed to the provider handler as written (`packages/services/service-automation/src/builtin/connector-nodes.ts:108`: `handler((cfg.input ?? {}) …)`); `builtin/value-slot-map.ts` resolves `fields`, `subflow`/`map` `input`, `script` `inputs`, `screen` `defaults`, `notify` `templateData` and `http` `body`, never connector `input`. The authoring door accepts a CEL envelope there: `FlowSchema.safeParse` of a flow whose `connectorConfig.input` is `{ path: { customer: { dialect: 'cel', source: 'record.stripe_customer_id' } } }` answers `success = true` and keeps the envelope verbatim (measured with `tsx` against `packages/spec/src/automation/flow.zod.ts` on this tree). The `openapi` handler then interpolates the path from `String(value)`, so the vendor receives an object stringified. Reach: `os validate` runs `FlowSchema`; producer: any app author's stored flow definition. Dedupe words: `connector_action input value slot CEL envelope verbatim`. The recipes state the limit; they do not work around it.
2. **The card's "`pnpm` skill evals" does not exist for the root catalog** — the eval fixtures under `skills/*/evals/` have no mechanical consumer in this repository; `ui/` has one for its own bundle. Observation for the PM (the acceptance wording), not a card from this seat.
3. **Pre-existing, observation only**: under the same whole-token rule, two existing evals in `evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` carry untaught tokens on base as well as on this branch — eval 7 (`excludeSubmitter: true`) and eval 8 (`type: 'screen'`, `type: 'file'`, `signed_copy`). No root gate asserts the rule; carrier: none.
4. `#25747` (the DocuSign instance the card cites as open) is closed `not_planned` as of 2026-10-28 — no effect on the premise, which was re-verified on `origin/main` a0aa8a1f: `pre-built integration connector` at `SKILL.md:89`; `defineConnector|provider: 'openapi'` → 0 files under `skills/*/references` and `skills/*/evals`; `Declaring a provider-bound instance` at `content/docs/automation/connectors.mdx:40`.
5. `references/examples-flows.md:49-55` (the plugin-registered `slack` connector in a `connector_action`) is outside the declared surface and was not edited; it stays a legitimate shape, and the rewritten `connector_action` row says so ("or a plugin's").
6. The `runAs: 'system'` paragraph in SKILL.md says a system sweep must pin its organization but names no column, and the catalog's own scheduled example carries no predicate; the Stripe recipe mirrors the taught shape and adds a one-line reminder. Read-only inference; noted, not filed.
7. Five derived families exit 3 locally (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`: they read built `dist/`, which this diff never builds) — `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:dts-closure`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:lean-entry-closure`, `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content`. They are pulled in by the `scripts/` touch, read none of the changed paths, and run in CI after the build; recorded as NOT MEASURED locally.
